chains.title: Alt T creates a hepatocyte CEBPA site that raises SORT1 and lowers LDL/MI risk

links.claim: Alt T binds CEBPA more strongly than ref G; the alt allele creates a C/EBP-family motif. CEBPA is chosen over related C/EBP factors from hepatic expression and published C/EBP occupancy at this 1p13 element. No QBiC-SELEX model is supplied, so this is not based on another TF's SELEX change.
The variant lies in a hepatocyte regulatory element/enhancer in the 1p13 locus, not a coding change; the alt allele increases element activity.
The alt allele increases SORT1 transcript levels in hepatocytes.
The effect occurs in hepatocytes, the liver cell type relevant to LDL clearance (Hep3B/HepG2 context).
Higher hepatic SORT1 lowers circulating LDL-C and lowers myocardial-infarction risk.

predictions: CEBPA ChIP at rs12740374 is higher on alt T than ref G in hepatocytes
SORT1 expression is higher from the alt T haplotype in hepatocytes
alt T is associated with lower LDL-C and lower MI risk
falsified_if: CEBPA ChIP shows no alt-specific enrichment while CEBPB does
SORT1 expression is not allele-specific in hepatocytes
the alt allele is not associated with lower LDL-C after controlling for LD

chains.title: Null: no TF-mediated allelic effect of rs12740374
predictions: No allele-specific CEBPA or CEBPB occupancy at rs12740374 in hepatocytes
No allele-specific SORT1 or CELSR2 expression attributable to this variant
Any association with LDL-C/MI is explained by LD with another causal variant or by no allelic effect
falsified_if: allele-specific CEBPA/CEBPB occupancy and allele-specific SORT1 expression persist after controlling for linked variants
CRISPR editing of rs12740374 alone changes SORT1 expression and LDL-C in a hepatocyte model

chains.title: Alt T creates a hepatocyte CEBPB site that raises SORT1 and lowers LDL/MI risk

links.claim: Alt T binds CEBPB more strongly than ref G; CEBPB shares the C/EBP motif with CEBPA and is expressed in hepatocytes, so it is a competing family member. No QBiC-SELEX model is supplied.
The variant lies in a hepatocyte regulatory element/enhancer in the 1p13 locus; the alt allele increases element activity.
The alt allele increases SORT1 transcript levels in hepatocytes.
The effect occurs in hepatocytes, the relevant liver cell type for LDL clearance.
Higher hepatic SORT1 lowers circulating LDL-C and lowers myocardial-infarction risk.

predictions: CEBPB ChIP at rs12740374 is higher on alt T than ref G in hepatocytes
SORT1 expression is higher from the alt T haplotype in hepatocytes
alt T is associated with lower LDL-C and lower MI risk
falsified_if: CEBPA ChIP shows alt-specific enrichment while CEBPB does not
CEBPB knockdown does not reduce the alt-specific element or SORT1 effect
SORT1 expression is not allele-specific in hepatocytes

chains.title: Alt T binds CEBPA but the element acts on CELSR2 rather than SORT1

links.claim: Alt T binds CEBPA more strongly than ref G via a created C/EBP motif; CEBPA is the hepatic C/EBP-family candidate. No QBiC-SELEX model is supplied.
The variant lies in a regulatory element in the 1p13 locus; the alt allele changes element activity.
The element acts on CELSR2 rather than SORT1, changing CELSR2 transcript levels.
Altered CELSR2 in hepatocytes changes LDL-C and myocardial-infarction risk.

predictions: CEBPA ChIP at rs12740374 is higher on alt T than ref G
CELSR2 expression is allele-specific in hepatocytes
SORT1 expression is not allele-specific at this variant
falsified_if: SORT1, not CELSR2, shows allele-specific expression in hepatocytes
CEBPA occupancy does not track the alt allele
CELSR2 perturbation does not affect LDL-C in relevant models

next_experiment: Allele-specific ChIP-qPCR for CEBPA and CEBPB at rs12740374 in Hep3B cells (or supershift EMSA with Hep3B nuclear extract and anti-CEBPA vs anti-CEBPB antibodies if ChIP is not feasible).
